high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the verified account "georgewbush" on Instagram. The post was made 44 minutes prior to the screenshot being taken at 5:16 PM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The post includes a message written by President George W. Bush. The text of the post reads: "Today, a young man was murdered in cold blood while expressing his political views. It happened on a college campus, where the open exchange of opposing ideas should be sacrosanct. Violence and vitriol must be purged from the public square
